_note: Per-slide auto-step recipe for narrated mode. Mirrors STEPS/SCHEME/FURNISHER in tools/record_sequences.py (kept in lockstep by tests/test_serve_presentation.py). Slides NOT listed here are single CSS entry reveals that auto-play on [data-deck-active] — the controller just plays audio and holds. kind: 'key' = the slide reveals an internal block/video on ArrowRight; 'click' = click 'sel' to reveal; 'scheme' = drive the SVG __scheme.forward() once per phase (count read live from __scheme.total); 'furnisher' = self-driving machine, no steps. Optional per-step 'via'/'domAction' override how a 'key' step is fired once verified in-browser. Optional per-step 'at' = fraction (0..1) of the narration audio's duration at which to fire the step instead of right after entry (e.g. 0.5 = midpoint), for reveals timed to the voice-over. 'narratedOnly': true marks a slide that exists ONLY in this web presentation (not in the video's record_sequences tables) — exempt from the lockstep parity test.
